messages.subject: Re: Env Data
messages.body_plain:
Dear Ailin,

One problem that you have is that your localities are in a geografic coordinates system (GCS) and your raster is in a projected coordinate system (More info).
 <https://gis.stackexchange.com/questions/182444/understanding-difference-between-coordinate-system-and-projection>
You need to convert your raster to a GCS. You can use the raster::projectRaster() funtion in R (More info <https://gis.stackexchange.com/questions/154276/how-to-reproject-a-raster-from-lat-lon-to-utm-in-r>) or the GIS of your preference (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS).

r <- raster(path_of your_raster)
# Define the Proj.4 spatial reference
sr <- "+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
# Project Raster projected_raster <- projectRaster(r, crs = sr)

Let me know if you need more help.

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.subject: Re: Env Data
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ailin,

I think that your machine specification is good enough to project your raster. I suggest to run the code in a "fresh" session in R. I just project your raster following the next code:

library(raster)
r <- raster(your_path_file)
crs(r) <- "+proj=utm +zone=20 +south +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"  # I assumed that the CRS of your original raster is WGS84 UTM 20

# Define the Proj.4 spatial reference
sr <- "+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
# Project Raster
projected_raster <- projectRaster(r, crs = sr)

writeRaster(r, filename = "name_for_the_projected_raster.tif")  # I suggest TIF files, but you can specificy ASC if you want.

Let me know if this works for you.

Best,
Gonzalo

Unfortunately, when am going for multiple beta multipliers (e.c 1>5 with 1 unit step) after running MAXENT with L1, LQ1, and H1 - system stop and inform that it cannot allocate vector of 1.2 GB.

Prior opening Wallace i run the > options(java.parameters = "-Xmx12000m") in order to increase the available RAM to MAXENT (but seems that it doesn't work).

How can we solve this issue ?

I have install the development version via Github.

Looiking forward

Dimitris
